descriptionLong: The Wireless Keyboard KEYGO, is a compact keyboard about the size of a standard tablet, making it easy to carry and ideal for working on the move. An extremely practical feature of this keyboard is its long operating time on a single charge, you can use it for up to 36 hours. The keyboard works with iOS, Android and Windows. The Bluetooth 3.0 connection will enable you to connect to devices such as smartphones, tablets and laptops.

descriptionLong: MIST is a revolutionary gadget for all those who want to clean their monitors quickly and easily. Simply spray on the dirty surface, wipe and enjoy a clean screen! Inside this practical cleaner is 15 ml of anti-static liquid, which effectively removes dirt while protecting the surface from dust settling back in. The case of the cleaner is encased in a microfibre coating, allowing you to effortlessly wipe the surface ensuring a clean, streak-free screen.
